<mxfile host="make_diagrams.py" type="device"><diagram name="One bug, and why every gate above silicon missed it" id="d0"><mxGraphModel dx="800" dy="600" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1000" pageHeight="500" math="0" shadow="0"><root><mxCell id="0" /><mxCell id="1" parent="0" /><mxCell id="rtl" value="corner_turn_v.v

busy <= 1'b1; fill_done <= 1'b0;
...
if (fill_done && ...) busy <= 1'b0;" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFEBEE;strokeColor=#B71C1C;fontSize=13;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="70" width="300" height="130" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="expl" value="Both assignments live in ONE always block. `fill_done <= 1'b0` is non-blocking, so the
later line still reads the PREVIOUS run's 1 — and being later, its `busy <= 1'b0` wins.

The kernel therefore works exactly ONCE per reset. Every start after the first
reports 'done' immediately and the pipeline runs on untransposed data." style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="370" y="70" width="600" height="130" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="c0" value="Model gate (bit-exact vs C)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFDE7;strokeColor=#B8860B;fontSize=12;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="240" width="300" height="34" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="r0" value="passed — it never runs the RTL" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="370" y="240" width="600" height="34" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="c1" value="Testbench, 3 cases, bit-exact" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFDE7;strokeColor=#B8860B;fontSize=12;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="280" width="300" height="34" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="r1" value="passed — each case RESET before its single run" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="370" y="280" width="600" height="34" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="c2" value="Mutation battery" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFDE7;strokeColor=#B8860B;fontSize=12;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="320" width="300" height="34" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="r2" value="passed — mutants were caught; the blind spot was structural" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="370" y="320" width="600" height="34" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="c3" value="Synthesis / place & route" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFDE7;strokeColor=#B8860B;fontSize=12;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="360" width="300" height="34" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="r3" value="passed" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="370" y="360" width="600" height="34" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="c4" value="Timing, setup AND hold" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFDE7;strokeColor=#B8860B;fontSize=12;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="400" width="300" height="34" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="r4" value="passed" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="370" y="400" width="600" height="34" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="c5" value="Silicon CRC" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFEBEE;strokeColor=#B71C1C;fontSize=12;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="440" width="300" height="34" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="r5" value="FAILED — 0x1e8226cf, then a hang" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="370" y="440" width="600" height="34" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="fix" value="Fix: one guard. Real lesson: the BENCH was the defect — it could not express 're-arm', so it could not fail." style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="470" width="930" height="24" as="geometry" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
svg.text: Both assignments live in ONE always block. `fill_done <= 1'b0` is non-blocking, so the
later line still reads the PREVIOUS run's 1 — and being later, its `busy <= 1'b0` wins.
The kernel therefore works exactly ONCE per reset. Every start after the first
reports 'done' immediately and the pipeline runs on untransposed data.
passed — it never runs the RTL
passed — each case RESET before its single run
passed — mutants were caught; the blind spot was structural
Fix: one guard. Real lesson: the BENCH was the defect — it could not express 're-arm', so it could not fail.
